skill.summary: Transform audio recordings into professional Markdown documentation with intelligent summaries using LLM integration

latestVersion.changelog:
audio-transcriber-pro v1.0.0

- Initial release of audio-transcriber-pro skill.
- Automates transcription of audio recordings to structured Markdown documents.
- Extracts rich metadata: speakers, timestamps, language, file size, and duration.
- Generates meeting minutes, action items, and executive summaries using LLM integration.
- Supports multiple audio formats, auto-detects best available transcription engine (Faster-Whisper/Whisper).
- Offers one-click dependency installation or manual setup guidance.
